units: <cite ref="Shabbat 67b:4">Sabb. 67ᵇ</cite> (in Hebr. dict.) <he>האומר לעורב … ולע׳ וכ׳</he> if one says to a raven, croak, and to a she-raven, shriek and turn thy tail towards me (a superstitious practice); differ. in <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:6">Tosef. ib.
